messages:
sam: Quick sync — planning integration of FlashAttn v2/v3 + fused/paged kernels into the runtime. Need a deterministic kernel-selection heuristic that considers model family, seq_len, batch_size, KV-cache usage, and streaming vs batched requests.

maria: Agreed. We also need safety gates for perf regressions and a small canary. I sketched an initial decision tree below.

perf-bot: Automated benchmark snapshot (macros): model=GPT-13B, shapes tested= {batch:1..8, seq:128/512/1024/2048}.
- flashattn_v3_fused: throughput=12.3k tok/s, p95=18ms, mem=7.4Gi
- flashattn_v2: throughput=10.1k tok/s, p95=22ms, mem=9.8Gi
- paged-attn (long-seq opt): throughput=4.6k tok/s, p95=65ms, mem=5.2Gi
- fused-naive: throughput=8.9k tok/s, p95=30ms, mem=8.1Gi
Note: V3 reduces mem by ~25% on int8 quantization profiles.

josh: Important KV notes: paged-attn trades compute for extra host<->device transfers on KV misses. Without prefetch we see 2–3x p95 regressions for chat workloads with large prefixes. We should add an async KV prefetch path and a metric for KV prefetch latency + misses.

anya: Proposed runtime heuristic (draft):
- if seq_len <= 1024 AND batch_size <= 4 AND !kv_streaming -> prefer flashattn_v3_fused
- else if kv_hit_rate < 0.9 AND avg_prefix_len > 2048 -> use paged-attn with prefetch flag
- else if v3 shows p95 > v2.p95 * 1.10 on recent 1h window -> fallback to v2 for that model version
- always cap tokens_per_batch <= 16384 to avoid scheduler thrash
(we'll turn these thresholds into fflags)

sam: Rollout plan outline:
- fflags: attn.kernel.v3_gate (global switch), attn.kernel.paged_prefetch, attn.kernel.debounce
- Canary: start at 5% traffic on dedicated rdw-canary clusters, collect p50/p95 latency, errors, gpu_util, tokens/s, mem_high_count.
- Pass criteria: no >7% increase in p95, error_rate delta <= +1ppt, no OOMs, memory high_count < 0.5% of reqs.
- Auto-rollback if any threshold violated during 15m sliding window.

maria: Add telemetry: per-model histograms for batch_size, seq_len, KV_hit_rate; expose a sampled KV-trace (stack + timings for copy/prefetch) for failing requests. Also add a gate that disables prefetch for private deployments by default.

perf-bot: Regression test run (50k tokens across shapes): combined v3+fused shows good lift in steady-state but found a rare scheduler thrash: batch=16 seq=2048 produced 3x latency spike in 0.1% of runs -> logged as ISSUE-2356.

josh: Mitigations for ISSUE-2356: add kernel cooldown debounce, limit concurrent kernel launches per GPU to N=6, and enforce max_tokens_per_batch=16384. These reduce the spike in local runs to <0.02%.

anya: For Private/On-prem we should keep v3 behind opt-in. Many customers run unusual shapes and we need to avoid surprises. Default for hosted: v3_gate=off -> staged on canary clusters -> enable once metrics stable.

sam: Action items I will take: 1) PR with selection function + fflags + unit tests, 2) Add perf regression harness job for attn kernels, 3) Dashboards for the new metrics, 4) Link to ISSUE-2356 mitigation. I'll tag owners in the PR.

maria: +1. Also please add a small smoke test that runs a long-chat KV scenario (prefix 6k tokens) to validate no excessive memcpy.

josh: I'll implement the async prefetch and the kernel-debounce logic. Will add microbench scripts.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary job queued for cluster rdw-canary-3 at 2026-04-02T10:00:00Z (job id rdw-canary-attn-042).

sam: Cool. If nobody objects I'll file the rollout doc + PR this afternoon.
maria: No objections. :thumbsup:

(ends)
